every-radio-callsign-spreadsheet.csv.contentsIndicative: header Created Date,Product,Reserved to Date,Status,Type,Value (UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF) - the widest register shape held. 159,999 data rows - 103,621 Allocated, 53,230 Reserved, 3,134 Available, 14 blank statuses. Product is the licence-product vocabulary verbatim (Full 59,053 / Foundation 35,780 / Intermediate 14,156 / Club 1,892 / Temporary Reciprocal 103, plus a special-event/permit family: Special Event Station 1,316 / NoV Special Event Station 2,256 / NoV Special Special Event Station 143 / Perm Special Event Station 32 / NoV Permanent Special Event Station 21 / Special Research Permit 1) and blank on 45,246 rows (the reserved pool). Created Date (day-first DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM, day-first verified: 106,421 rows carry a day>12) spans 2016-07-23..2024-09-10; Reserved to Date present on 4,319 rows, spanning 2016-01-04..2099-12-31 (a 'permanent' reservation-expiry placeholder). Type is NOT constant here (156,048 'Call Sign - Amateur' + 3,951 'Call Sign - NoV', the Notice-of-Variation callsigns) and is not derivable from Product (Special Event Station appears under both types), so it is carried, not dropped. Anomalies preserved verbatim: one '.' callsign and two blank callsigns; four trailing-NBSP callsigns (2E1HON/G0TQK/G7IWE/GB2DWM, UTF-8 0xC2 0xA0) - trimmed, counted, then colliding with clean duplicates; four interior-space callsigns (G6 FMU, GB 8IMD, GB GU75LIB, M/TKG 2021); 15 Excel-mangled 20xxx callsigns served as dates plus a numeric-only 22032024 (a mangled 22/03/2024); lower-case 'g0jrk'/'2e1GTD'; 153 over-length callsigns (GB100... centenary specials, EDUCATIONAL, ENVIRONMENTS).

normalised--every-radio-callsign-spreads.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,call_sign_type,created_date,reserved_to_date; 159,999 rows sorted by callsign. Status and licence_class (from Product) carried verbatim, empty where the source asserts none (45,246 blank licence_class, 14 blank status). call_sign_type carries the verbatim Type ('Call Sign - Amateur'/'Call Sign - NoV') because it varies here and is not derivable from Product (the sole register snapshot where Type is a per-row assertion, not a dropped discriminator). created_date and reserved_to_date ISO-rendered from the day-first source, time-of-day kept; reserved_to_date is a validity END so future values (to 2099-12-31) are accepted. The '.' and blank callsigns, the trimmed trailing-NBSP quartet, the interior-space and Excel-mangled callsigns are all preserved.
